public_health_question.v: Following FDA's updated Heplisav-B labeling for pregnancy, which HepB vaccines may providers use to vaccinate pregnant persons needing HepB vaccination?

ev.q: Providers can now administer Engerix-B, Heplisav-B, Recombivax HB, or Twinrix to pregnant persons needing HepB vaccination.
